risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and transparent, with extensive quantitative detail on earnings, cash flow, debt, share repurchases, margins, and one-time items. Risk exposure is concentrated in consumer demand, markdowns, sourcing, inflationary inputs, seasonality, and construction-sector pricing pressure, while management presents a moderately confident outlook. Reported earnings benefited materially from tax and litigation-related items, which reduces the apparent quality of recurring earnings.
